title: Will It Be Possible to Cure All Cancers? A Design-Only Framework for Testing Broad Immune Recognition and Durable Cancer Control
framework: PAN-CURE (Pan-cancer Antigen and Networked Cure Readiness Evaluation)
claim_boundary: The report does not claim that all cancers can be cured, that MR1-restricted T-cell receptor findings prove a pan-cancer therapy, or that any patient, animal, cell, tumor, safety, survival, or relapse outcome was obtained.
